paras: Give your Nissan R35 GTR the exhaust note it deserves with the all-new Xforce VAREX valved Cat-Back Exhaust System . Crafted from premium 304 stainless steel , this system is designed to balance iconic supercar sound with everyday usability , offering the ultimate combination of style, tone, and control.

The exhaust features dual 3” front sections that bolt to the factory system merging into a single 3.5” main pipe , engineered for optimal flow and durability. At the rear, a bespoke VAREX valved muffler has been specifically designed for the R35 GTR, delivering a deep, aggressive roar when open , and a refined, subtle tone when closed —perfect for both spirited drives and city cruising. When paired with the optional SmartBox , you can automate sound control via speed, throttle position, RPM, or GPS location.
hl: Premium 304 stainless steel construction for strength and longevity
Dual 3” to single 3.5” free-flowing design for smooth exhaust gas transition
Bespoke VAREX valved rear muffler for maximum sound control
Quad 5” polished tips for a commanding, factory-style finish
Aggressive supercar tone when open, refined and subtle when closed
Direct bolt-on fitment with all required hardware included
ft: Xforce Nissan GT-R R35 3.5" Varex Valved Catback System
